title: JWF/NFP Maintenance Service 2027 - 2031
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > LRD > W072 ENDIST HUNTINGTON
description: Contractor shall furnish all necessary management, personnel, materials, supplies, tools, equipment, fuel, and vehicles, except as otherwise noted in the Performance Work Statement, required to perform the Mowing and Maintenance Services for John W. Flannagan Dam Reservoir and North Fork of Pound River Lake, VA. All work shall be completed in accordance with the Performance Work Statement and terms and conditions of the contract. The not-to-exceed amount of $3,000,000.00 includes the base year and all options exercised.
